repolish.setting.name: Clip name
repolish.setting.name.tooltip: File name used under the repolish folder in your game directory.
repolish.setting.fov.tooltip: Used while previewing or recording when custom FOV is on.
repolish.setting.smoothing.tooltip: Removes small TAS camera shake. Zero keeps the raw look.
repolish.setting.responsiveness.tooltip: Keeps fast flicks on the action. Low values start to trail like spectator mode.
repolish.recordings.empty: No recordings yet. They are saved in the repolish folder after you stop a take.
repolish.hint: Press Esc and click Stop recording to finish a take. Recordings are also listed from the main menu. Smoothing takes the shake out of a TAS look. Responsiveness keeps flicks on the action instead of trailing like the spectator camera.
repolish.chat.marker_idle: Start a recording before placing markers.
